features.name: Restore Balance
features.desc: As a Reaction, when a creature within 60 feet rolls with Advantage or Disadvantage, you cancel it (the roll has neither). Number of uses equals your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.desc: For 1–5 Sorcery Points, you create a shield of d8s (one per point) for yourself or a creature within 30 feet; it absorbs damage by expending the dice.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute: attack rolls against you can't have Advantage, and when you roll a 9 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can treat the roll as a 10.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.desc: As an action (once per Long Rest), you summon clockwork spirits in a 30-foot Cube: they heal, repair objects, and end spells.
